item.title: Margaret Smyth
item.description: Margaret Smyth Corsillago, Lisnalong, Monaghan. Saturday 10th January, peacefully at Cavan General Hospital surrounded by her loving family. Predeceased by her parents Tommy and Mary. Margaret will repose at Smyths funeral home Ballybay eircode A75 RH96 on Sunday 11th January from 2pm - 6pm. Removal from Margarets home on Monday morning to arrive at Saint Michael’s Church Cootehill for 11am funeral mass. Interment afterwards in adjoining cemetery. Family flowers only please donations if desired

May He Rest in Peace Felix will be reposing at his residence (H14 Y938) on Monday 12th January from 4pm until evening prayers at 8pm. item.title: Status Yellow wind warning issued for eleven counties
item.description: A Status Yellow wind warning for 11 counties comes into effect from 4 o'clock this afternoon until midnight tonight. The warning has been issued for counties Clare, Cork, Kerry, Waterford, Donegal, Galway, Leitrim, Mayo, Sligo, Wexford and Wicklow. A Status Yellow Rain warning is in place the north for counties Antrim, Armagh, Down, Fermanagh, Tyrone, and Derry until 9pm tonight. item.description: Social Welfare increases which have taken effect from January 1st will see a rise in numerous payments including a €10 increase in the maximum rate of all core weekly payments, for pensioners, carers and individuals with disabilities. Monaghan Senator Robbie Gallagher believes the new increases will assist those most in need during the ongoing cost of living pressures. item.title: Late John Manuel Morehart praised for restoration of Bellamont Forest
item.description: An Taisce, one of Ireland's oldest and largest environmental organisations have paid tribute to the late John Manuel Morehart on his restoration of Bellamont Forest in Cavan. The house is noted in the National Built Heritage Service survey: as an iconic building of national importance. It is considered the best and earliest example of a Palladian villa in Ireland. item.title: Exhibition on history of Protestant Association of Cavan to be launched
item.description: An exhibition on the history of the Protestant Association of Cavan which launched in December is continuing, with another exhibition launching in the Monaghan Peace Campus next month. 'A voice of their own: The Protestant Associations of Cavan. Donegal, and Monaghan 1920 - 2016', aims to give a perspective of the unique history of these associations, and bring an opportunity for renewed dialogue and reconciliation of the past. item.title: Local TD meeting with X executives over explicit use of AI tool
item.description: Executives at X will meet with junior minister and local TD Niamh Smyth, according to the Irish Independent. It comes after the AI platform Grok was used to create sexually explicit images of people, including children. Only paid subscribers can now generate and edit images with the tool. item.title: Monaghan squeeze past Fermanagh
item.description: Monaghan’s preseason preparation continued as they overcame Fermanagh in Castleblayney on Sunday afternoon. However, Monaghan had to work for it by Fermanagh, needing a strong second-half finish to book a home McKenna Cup semi-final. Stephen Mooney, David Garland and Fionan Carolan kicked Monaghan into a three point lead after five minutes.
